# EXECUTION PROMPT — CYC-55: Remove Print Framing from Testing Page Manuals

> Generated for target repo `cycleforge-app` from goal: *[LINEAR CYC-55] Testing page: remove paperwork concerns, focus on test + ready-to-pack only

Investigation (loop, 2026-08-28): the Testing page (/test, legacy /tech) renders NO paperwork UI today — no order-document panels, no packing-slip/invoice affordances (checked build-testing-displays.tsx, ActiveOrderWorkspace.tsx, grep across src/components/tech + station). Paperwork already lives on outbound Labels, kiosk, and repair. The one remaining print-framed affordance on Testing is the SKU Manuals display — this issue now covers exactly that.

## Closest alternative small change (serves CYC-55's intent)

The one document affordance on the Testing page that carries **print framing** is the SKU Manuals display (Testing Displays → Manuals). Its per-row action is labeled "View / print manual" with a `Printer` icon, and the header "View" button also uses a `Printer` icon. Per the JIT-pack-documents direction (printing inserts belongs at pack), keep manual **viewing** on Testing (the tech reads the manual to test) but drop the print framing.

**File: **`src/components/tech/sku-testing/ManualsSection.tsx` (only file touched)

No other call sites reference the removed strings (`grep -rn "View / print manual"` hits only this file; no test depends on it). The shared `DocumentSlideOver` (`src/design-system/components/DocumentSlideOver.tsx`) keeps its own "Print active document" header action — untouched, since it serves other surfaces.

Work required: one bounded edit to `src/components/tech/sku-testing/ManualsSection.tsx` (5 lines: drop the unused `Printer` import, swap two icons to `FileText`, relabel tooltip + ariaLabel to "View manual"); verify with `npm run verify:fast`; visual acceptance: on `/test`, open a testing line with paired SKU manuals → Displays → Manuals — the header "View" button and each manual row show a document (FileText) icon with tooltip "View manual", no printer glyphs or "print" wording anywhere in the section, and clicking still opens the manual in the slide-over.
